It depends on how you view your abilities. For example, the air force isn't just made up of pilots, it is made up of intelligence analysts, coordination teams, engineers, military vehicle drivers, and many more also. So you have to ask yourself a few questions:

  • Am I strong and fit enough to do ground work? If so joining the army or navy may suit you.

  • Am I smart enough to do any of the behind-the-scenes work? In which case, any of the three will suit you, as long as you apply for the right role. If you are trained an an engineer, then you should consider applying to the one that uses the vehicles you want to work on e.g. big guns = navy or army, planes = air force, tanks = army etc.

  • Can I take orders without that eventually being a problem? If this is a problem, perhaps the military isn't for you, but if you are intelligent you may eventually become a higher rank and be in a role better suited to you.

This should get you started, but you should have a close look at the various military roles available first before you apply.
